verdicts.reason: A: the attribution 'THE SOLSTICE TASTING TEAM' is set bolder and nearly as large as the quote, so the hierarchy is inverted. The hero can has shrunk to a speck inside the circle and the SOLSTICE logo is effectively gone, which loses the product and the brand. B keeps the quote dominant and readable and keeps the can at a good size, but the logo is a tiny illegible fragment floating mid-canvas. The attribution is shrunk to unreadable fine print and pushed to the bottom edge, far from its quote, and the oversized quote mark eats the top.
